Islington Folk Club


"From the fiercely traditional to the frankly eccentric"

Forthcoming programme | History of the club | Trad2Mad | The club online | About us | Site map

The Islington Folk Club is an old-established club which has met at various venues since the early 1970s. Its continuing aim is to present the best available artists, from the fiercely traditional to the frankly eccentric. The guest artists are supported every week by the house band--The Angel Band.

You can keep up with club news on our Facebook page: Islington Folk Club.

Bob Davenport

The club is very sad to have to report the death of Bob Davenport, 1932-2026. Bob was the club's MC and main resident singer from the mid 1970s until 1986, firstly at the Florence and subsequently for many years at the Empress of Russia. From 1984 he and Roger Digby were also in charge of booking guests. Previously, from 1964 to 1967, Bob was a leading light of one of our predecessor clubs, at the Fox on Islington Green.

Bob touched the lives of so many past and present members of Islington Folk Club. I'm sure all of us wish to express our sympathy to all Bob's family and close friends.

For more, see David Campbell's History of the club on this site and Bob Davenport: From Gateshead to Newport

Programme

Our next guest

29th October 2026 Louise and Chris Rogan Both fine singers in close family harmonies, this father-daughter duo, with Louise on piano and Chris on stringed instruments, perform their combination of traditional and original songs. They have played and headlined major festival stages and their album 'Things That Matter' has won rave reviews. Louise has also released a solo album. Immensely good.
‘... nothing quite prepared me for the quality of Louise's vocals and the wonderful on-set chemistry of the combination’ Rory Stanbridge, FATEA

To receive weekly information contact Membership giving your full name and email address.

We meet on Thursdays (except in July, August, and the Christmas break); the evenings begin at 8pm (doors open by 7.30) and end around 10.30pm.

Venue

The club is held upstairs at:

The Brewhouse & Kitchen
2a Corsica Street
London
N5 1JJ.

The pub is just off Highbury Corner. Highbury and Islington station (Victoria line, London Overground, and National Rail) is a couple of minutes away. Bus routes 4, 19, 30, 263 and 393 stop in St Paul's Road almost outside the pub; routes 21 and 43 stop nearby in Holloway Road. Public transport information can be obtained from Transport for London. There are maps on StreetMap UK or OpenStreetMap.

Admission

Admission, payable on the door by cash or card is £10.00 (£8.00 for concessions). Members pay £8.00 (£6.00 for concessions) and Membership is £2.00 for a calendar year. On the rare occasions when we sell advance tickets this will be made clear in the listings.

Floor singers are very welcome--we can usually fit you in; please note that we don't offer any reduction in the normal admission price. If you're looking for a booking, contact the Booking officers --but much the best way of being considered is to come along and do a floor spot.
